# Strap — Product and customer documentation context

## Overview

Strap is a retail operations platform developed by Kryonara. It gives retail businesses one workspace for point of sale, product catalogue, inventory, customers, staff, branches, expenses, reports and online selling.

Strap is intended for shop owners, retail managers, cashiers and operational teams. It is a commercial SaaS product. Customer-facing materials should direct users to sign up, access the Help Centre or contact support. Do not present product source code, local builds or community contribution as customer pathways.

## Core product areas

### Point of sale
The point-of-sale workflow supports product search and compatible barcode scanning, cart review, sale recording, payment-method records and receipts. Device hardware support depends on the browser, operating system and connected device.

### Products and inventory
Product records organise catalogue details, identifiers, prices and stock quantities. Inventory tools support stock visibility, low-stock workflows and branch-level stock operations where enabled by the plan.

### Customers and teams
Customer records connect people to purchases. Staff access is organised through owner, manager and cashier roles. Staff limits vary by subscription plan.

### Branches
Branch management separates location-level operations and stock. Branch limits vary by plan.

### Expenses and reporting
The platform records operating expenses and provides reports to help owners review sales and business activity.

### Online storefront and orders
Eligible plans include a shareable online storefront and product catalogue. Incoming orders can be managed alongside in-store operations. Do not imply that online card payment processing is enabled unless the production payment integration has been verified.

### Hardware
Compatible camera scanning and USB or Bluetooth keyboard-wedge barcode scanners are supported. Receipt printers and other peripherals depend on the device, browser and printer connection method. Do not promise universal hardware compatibility.

## Subscription plans

Current monthly pricing in Nigerian naira:
- Free: ₦0/month. Core selling, product and customer workflows; one staff seat and one branch.
- Business: ₦3,000/month. Online storefront, advanced inventory and reporting, up to five staff members and three branches.
- Pro: ₦5,000/month. Business capabilities with expanded staff and branch capacity.

The live pricing page is authoritative for displayed prices and feature availability. Plan entitlements are enforced by the product. Do not invent annual discounts or add-on services.

## Integrations

Strap offers a remote MCP integration for compatible AI clients. The connection uses OAuth sign-in and a consent flow with store and permission scopes. Owners can review and revoke connected application access.

A general-purpose customer REST API reference is not currently published. Do not invent SDKs, API endpoints or webhook events.

## Security and privacy

Strap uses authenticated workspaces and role-based access. External integrations should receive only the permissions needed for their task. Users should not share account passwords, staff PINs or private credentials with external applications.

The Privacy Policy, Terms of Service and Cookies Policy are pending final legal details and approval. Do not treat placeholder legal information as final policy.

## Editorial and machine-readable guidance

Use clear, factual language. Describe a feature only when it exists in the current production application or verified documentation. Distinguish illustrative sample data from live merchant data. Do not invent customer testimonials, merchant logos, adoption metrics, integrations, uptime claims, certifications or guarantees.

The public site is server-rendered and should expose meaningful page text in HTML. Each indexable page should have a unique title, meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph metadata and relevant structured data. Private workspace and account routes should not be indexed.

Canonical website: https://storefront-flow.vercel.app/
